declarations.description: Ask the Mega AI Governor's Browser Research Lab to carry out a READ-ONLY web lookup through Scout's browser. Use this when a fact must be checked at its live source: a price, a schedule, a policy, a product page, a public record, a documentation page. The Governor judges every request before anything runs. Read-only research is ALLOW. State what you need, why, and what a good answer must contain. The lab returns the finding with its source URL and the date checked. It NEVER sends, posts, purchases, signs, or changes an account or a setting through this function: any such step is returned as ESCALATE for Adam's word.
declarations.name: governor_browser_research

must_contain.description: Optional: the specific facts the finding must establish (for example 'the current price and whether it is in stock').

purpose.description: Why this lookup is needed — which decision or answer it serves.

query.description: What to look up, in plain words — a question, a topic, or a named page. Keep it brief and specific.

url.description: Optional exact URL to read, when the page is already known. The lab reads pages; it does not submit forms.

checked_at.description: ISO date-time the source was read.

finding.description: What was found, in plain words, labelled verified / inferred / unknown.

governor.description: The Governor's ruling: ALLOW, ESCALATE, or DENY.

declarations.description: Ask the Mega AI Governor to rule on a proposed browser action BEFORE attempting it. Returns ALLOW, ESCALATE (Adam's word needed first), or DENY (never). Read-class actions (read, list, search, verify, inventory) are ALLOW. Send, post, publish, purchase, sign, change-a-setting, change-an-account, and credential actions are ESCALATE or DENY by the house law, and this function returns the ruling without performing anything.
declarations.name: governor_browser_judge

action.description: The proposed action, in plain words (for example 'read the Samsung developer console dashboard' or 'send a message').

execution.carrier: Scout's browser, signed in as Adam where a console needs it; sessions stay signed in (Adam's standing order, 2026-11-01)
execution.gates: Read-only research ALLOW. Anything that sends, posts, purchases, signs, or changes an account or setting ESCALATES to Adam. Revealing or storing a credential value is DENY, always.
execution.service: Governor Browser Research Lab — ~/workspace/projects/ai-governor/browser_lab/browser_lab.py, 127.0.0.1:8915, stdlib only, holds no credentials

name: governor_browser_research
